title: obione pedunculata
intro: Obione pedunculata, commonly known as "Sea Purslane", is a succulent halophyte plant that grows in coastal areas, often found in salt marshes and beaches. The plant is rich in various bioactive constituents, which provide numerous health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and anti-cancer properties. The therapeutic actions of Sea Purslane include wound healing, antimicrobial, and anti-inflammatory activities, making it useful for treating wounds, skin conditions, and digestive issues. The bioactive constituents present in Sea Purslane include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
